headline: Mooring and Expanse Burn as Hollow Goes Quiet
war_summary: Since the last edition Mooring County and the Weathered Expanse have carried the fighting while Marban Hollow has gone quiet. Mooring now stands eight Warden, three Colonial and one neutral after two changes in two hours and sixty-three in twenty-four hours about Gravekeeper's Holdfast, MacConmara Barrows and the Wind Hills, with 6,532 Colonial and 6,931 Warden casualties in the day and hourly rates cooling from earlier peaks. The Weathered Expanse stands one Warden, five Colonial and three neutral after six changes in two hours and eighty-one in the day about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch, with 6,862 and 10,353 lost. Stlican Shelf shows three changes in two hours and nine in the day about Briar and Breaker Town at one Warden to eight Colonial with 949 and 1,259 lost and hourly rates accelerating. Marban Hollow, Callahan's Passage, the Nevish Line, Olavis Wake and Gutter record no changes in the last two hours, with Marban holding one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral after thirteen changes in six hours centred on Checkpoint Bua.
